description: This is a PHP class file defining the LeaveConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class extends ConfigService and provides methods to get and set leave configuration settings such as entitlement strategies, work schedule implementation, leave balances, and leave period status.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class extending ConfigService to manage leave-related configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the leave entitlement consumption strategy configuration value.

methods.name: getWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Retrieves the work schedule implementation configuration value.

methods.name: includePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Determines whether pending leave is included in leave balance calculations.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Sets the leave period status configuration value.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period status configuration value.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Sets whether the leave period has been defined.

methods.name: isLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the leave period has been set.
